{"note":"Geometry unchanged: no usable fit feedback was available. Final knob fit_af remains an UNVERIFIED 7.90 mm. Coupon throat sizes are 7.80, 7.90, 8.00 and 8.10 mm (not 8.01). Print and test the coupon before using the knob. Finished knob is one printed piece with a recessed, rotation-captured M5 nut, friction-retention ribs, and a retaining floor around a bolt clearance hole.","questions":[{"text":"Measured nut dimensions?","answer":"User cannot measure; nominal catalog dimensions used."},{"text":"Did any printed pocket pass the fit test?","answer":"No usable result reported for any pocket; fit remains unverified."}],"params":{"nut_af":{"value":8,"unit":"mm","kind":"hardware","source":"catalog","note":"ISO 4032 M5 nominal across flats; actual nut unmeasured."},"nut_h":{"value":4.7,"unit":"mm","kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":5,"unit":"mm","kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_clearance":{"value":0.6,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Diametral allowance."},"knob_d":{"value":30,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"floor_t":{"value":3,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"pocket_extra_depth":{"value":1.3,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"pocket_af_clearance":{"value":0.4,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"fit_af":{"value":7.9,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design","note":"UNVERIFIED effective width across opposing rib tips. Set to the successful coupon value before final printing."},"rib_r":{"value":0.45,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"lead_height":{"value":1,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"rib_count":{"value":6,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_count":{"value":12,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_r":{"value":3,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_center_r":{"value":17,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_d":{"value":14,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_pitch":{"value":16,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_link_w":{"value":4,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_fit_start":{"value":7.8,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_fit_step":{"value":0.1,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_count":{"value":4,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"cut_overrun":{"value":0.2,"unit":"mm","kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"import math

def build(p):
    h = p.floor_t + p.nut_h + p.pocket_extra_depth
    pocket_af = p.nut_af + p.pocket_af_clearance
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(h)
    for i in range(int(p.scallop_count)):
        a = 2*math.pi*i/p.scallop_count
        x,y = p.scallop_center_r*math.cos(a),p.scallop_center_r*math.sin(a)
        tool = cq.Workplane('XY').center(x,y).circle(p.scallop_r).extrude(h+p.cut_overrun)
        body = body.cut(tool)
    pocket = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_t).polygon(6,pocket_af/math.cos(math.pi/6)).extrude(h-p.floor_t+p.cut_overrun)
    body = body.cut(pocket)
    center_r = p.fit_af/2 + p.rib_r
    tip_r = max(p.cut_overrun, center_r-pocket_af/2+p.cut_overrun)
    for i in range(int(p.rib_count)):
        a = math.pi/6 + i*2*math.pi/p.rib_count
        x,y = center_r*math.cos(a),center_r*math.sin(a)
        rib = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_t).center(x,y).circle(p.rib_r).extrude(h-p.floor_t-p.lead_height)
        lead = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=h-p.lead_height).center(x,y).circle(p.rib_r).workplane(offset=p.lead_height).circle(tip_r).loft()
        body = body.union(rib).union(lead)
    hole = cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clearance)/2).extrude(h+p.cut_overrun)
    return body.cut(hole).clean()
","print_orientation":"Broad closed underside on bed at z=0; hex pocket opens upward. No supports.","use_orientation":"Nut presses into the open hex pocket and seats on its floor. Bolt passes axially through the nut and floor hole."},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"import math

def build(p):
    h = p.floor_t + p.nut_h + p.pocket_extra_depth
    pocket_af = p.nut_af + p.pocket_af_clearance
    result = None
    for j in range(int(p.coupon_count)):
        x0 = j*p.coupon_pitch
        fit = p.coupon_fit_start + j*p.coupon_fit_step
        body = cq.Workplane('XY').center(x0,0).circle(p.coupon_d/2).extrude(h)
        pocket = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_t).center(x0,0).polygon(6,pocket_af/math.cos(math.pi/6)).extrude(h-p.floor_t+p.cut_overrun)
        body = body.cut(pocket)
        center_r = fit/2+p.rib_r
        tip_r = max(p.cut_overrun,center_r-pocket_af/2+p.cut_overrun)
        for i in range(int(p.rib_count)):
            a = math.pi/6+i*2*math.pi/p.rib_count
            x,y = x0+center_r*math.cos(a),center_r*math.sin(a)
            rib = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_t).center(x,y).circle(p.rib_r).extrude(h-p.floor_t-p.lead_height)
            lead = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=h-p.lead_height).center(x,y).circle(p.rib_r).workplane(offset=p.lead_height).circle(tip_r).loft()
            body = body.union(rib).union(lead)
        hole = cq.Workplane('XY').center(x0,0).circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clearance)/2).extrude(h+p.cut_overrun)
        body = body.cut(hole)
        result = body if result is None else result.union(body)
    link = cq.Workplane('XY').center((p.coupon_count-1)*p.coupon_pitch/2,0).rect((p.coupon_count-1)*p.coupon_pitch,p.coupon_link_w).extrude(p.floor_t)
    result = result.union(link)
    for j in range(int(p.coupon_count)):
        hole = cq.Workplane('XY').center(j*p.coupon_pitch,0).circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clearance)/2).extrude(h+p.cut_overrun)
        result = result.cut(hole)
    return result.clean()

Put its flat underside on the bed; pockets face up. No supports. Use identical slicer compensation and print settings for the final knob.","parts":["fit_coupon"]},{"n":"2","text":"In the slicer identify local X=0,16,32,48 mm pocket centers: their effective rib-tip widths are respectively 7.80, 7.90, 8.00, 8.10 mm. Mark them on the print before losing track of orientation. The last value is 8.10, not 8.01.","parts":["fit_coupon"]},{"n":"3","text":"Start with the 8.10 mm pocket and work toward smaller sizes if needed. Align the nut flats with the hex pocket and press straight down by hand. Stop if excessive force is needed; do not hammer, heat, or use a vise. A passing fit reaches the floor, leaves the nut fully recessed, and holds it when inverted and gently tapped over a tray.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"4","text":"Check your intended M5 bolt passes through the floor hole and threads through the seated nut. To recover the nut, push it toward the open pocket with a slender blunt rod through the floor hole; avoid prying against the ribs. If no coupon pocket passes, do not assume the default knob fits: adjust coupon_fit_start, reprint and test again. Record each result as too tight, passes, or too loose.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"],"tool":"Optional slender blunt rod for removing the test nut"},{"n":"5","text":"Set fit_af to the successful coupon width, then generate and print knob with the same settings. If printing the submitted default 7.90 mm knob unchanged, treat it as unverified unless the 7.90 mm coupon has passed. Let the print cool and clear any loose strings.","parts":["knob"]},{"n":"6","text":"Align the M5 nut and press it fully down to the floor by hand. Confirm it is recessed and retained when inverted. No glue is required. Screw the knob onto your intended M5 bolt, or feed the bolt through the underside and nut; use sufficient threaded length for the application. This design captures a nut, not the bolt head.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"7","text":"Use for light-duty hand tightening only, without pliers or added leverage. Stop if the nut spins or the plastic cracks. Keep away from heat; PLA can soften or relax. Recheck retention periodically and replace the knob if the fit loosens.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]}]}
